scope: reconciled facts and exact/banded semantic comparison for explicit synthetic targets; sporting intent/tolerance remains per-recipe
question: How can completed observations be interpreted without transport/identity/missingness creating false adherence or exposure?

source_manifest.use: canonical identity, observed/target lineage, unknowns, continuity and ownership
facts, source/revision, comparison and scoped hold/agency
no double count, deliberate adaptations and return
configuration, load convention, effort and strength outcomes
authority, nonclinical boundaries, missing eligibility, G03 joint review
candidate representation aid only; not recipe authority
method/scale caution only; no new mapping/dose/tolerance/threshold approval
contextual only; no clinical screening/clearance algorithm

target_lineage.segment_key: Strength set + side/role or Run block + repeat-instance
target_lineage.constraint: Completed prefix retains actual executed target revision; current/latest target is not substituted retrospectively.

reconciled_fact.revision_rule: Use explicit verified source/correction lineage, never newest receipt time; opaque lineage stays unresolved.

dimension.constraint: Only KNOWN carries a usable value; zero is not missing; no modality/machine/per-hand convention transfer by assumption.

intensity.constraint: Zone numbers and session/interval/set RPE are not portable or averaged. RPE fixture does not certify physiological threshold.

comparability.constraint: Keep per-dimension results; missing critical dimension blocks aggregate interpretation, not independent valid facts.

freshness.constraint: No universal TTL; historic observation remains historic fact even when unsuitable for current readiness. Receipt time cannot make old observation current.

exposure.past: known observed part once; unknown remainder explicit; no planned+matched-observed sum
exposure.future: only valid future remainder projected separately
exposure.derived: local/muscle/systemic/interaction projections reference existing exposure without new session or duplicate contribution

interpretation.constraint: Transport completion, structural completion, honouring target, physiological stimulus and adaptation are distinct.

comparator.range_rule: Only an explicitly targeted band is admitted; no extra tolerance invented. Numeric result retains metric direction and construct.
comparator.adherence_honoured_condition: Known complete required coverage + every required semantic dimension conforming to actual executed target under this exact method. Does not assert physiological intent, technique, safety or progression.
comparator.critical_missing_result: UNCLASSIFIED with known dimensional facts preserved
comparator.above_target_result: record once; no extra adherence credit; G02 adequacy review only when materiality supports it

rules.name: Target actually executed
rules.must: Compare each segment against its immutable executed target, original/adapted history preserved.

rules.name: Dimensional method/configuration
rules.must: Use compatible units/conventions, method/calibration/context and coverage; classify dimensions independently.

rules.name: Known partial vs unobserved
rules.must: Explicit omitted/stopped fact differs from absent delivery; missing past remainder is unknown.

rules.name: Identity before aggregation
rules.must: Confirmed mirror/retry yields one fact; similarity alone cannot merge real sessions or count twice.

rules.name: Correction replaces scope
rules.must: Recompute from active revision once, retain prior frontier, prevent replay of superseded source.

rules.name: Freshness by decision
rules.must: Relevant new context can invalidate current-use suitability while historical fact remains; no universal time threshold.

rules.name: No merit or automatic mutation
rules.must: No universal adherence percent, credit for excess, debt replacement, earned progression or cause inferred from one deviation.

rules.name: Exposure once
rules.must: No planned+observed duplication, no local+systemic/interaction counting as extra work.

open_gaps.missing: Approved sporting intent/tolerance criteria for every activated recipe
open_gaps.blocks: Automatic physiological adherence/intent and dependent progression of uncovered recipe
Only dependent interpretation, not honest recording
Runtime/release gate; no implementation in this mission

open_gaps.missing: Provider, legal/purpose and implementation validity before real use
